statement: The unchanged pinned Hifiasm window-51 baseline is recorded for three synthetic 60–100 kbp cases. Window 101 reduced indexed seed occurrences by 48.4–48.9% and yielded byte-identical primary FASTA/GFA and all GFA outputs in five paired comparisons per case, with equal QUAST quality. All three performance screening gates failed; no performance improvement is promoted.
status: Completed local starter trial; baseline and observations author-checked only. Independent replay and maintainer review pending.
scope: Three synthetic haploid circular genomes; one development and two pre-frozen heldouts. Mac14,2 ARM64, source-built x86 Hifiasm under Rosetta, severe external contention. CPU reductions 5.99–9.88% are exploratory; no arbitrary-input exactness or real-read generalization claim.

assumptions.statement: Performance must survive an independent idle native-x86 replay.
Real nonhuman reads, larger genomes and fresh heldouts remain untested.
Maintainer has agreed to ownership but has not scientifically accepted the findings.

prerequisites: Python 3.9+ for offline evidence check; no vendor binary needed
For full replay first run the permission-aware pinned bootstrap; see README.md
Idle native-x86 host required before a portable performance claim
